```{r setup, echo = FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
```

```{r all-data, echo = FALSE}
# List of sims
nettypes <- c(
  "ergm"   = "ERGM",
  "degseq" = "Degree Sequence",
  "ergm+degseq" = "ERGM + Degree Sequence",
  original = "Baseline",
  permute = "Permutation"
  )

for (ntype in names(nettypes)) {

  # Retrieving results
  tmp_data <- list.files(
    "simoutbreak-data",
    pattern = sprintf(
      "%s-sim.+total_hist",
      gsub("([+.*])", "\\\\\\1", ntype)
      ),
    full.names = TRUE
    )

  # Reading the files
  tmp_data <- lapply(tmp_data, fread)
  tmp_data <- rbindlist(tmp_data)
  tmp_data[, model := nettypes[ntype]]

  tmp_name <- gsub("[^a-zA-Z_]+", "_", ntype)


  tmp_deseased <- tmp_data[status == "Deseased"]

  assign(sprintf("%s_deseased", tmp_name), tmp_data[status == "Deseased"])

  # Computing quantiles
  tmp_data <- tmp_data[, .(
    `2.5%` = quantile(counts, probs = .025),
    `Mean` = mean(counts),
    `97.5%` = quantile(counts, probs = .975)
  ), by = .(date, status)]

  assign(sprintf("%s_data", tmp_name), tmp_data)
  
  rm(tmp_name, tmp_data, tmp_deseased)

}

```



```{r meandist}

for (d in ls(pattern = "^.+_deseased")) {
  get(d)[,
  .(
    Mean = mean(counts),
    Var  = sd(counts)/sqrt(.N)
    ), by = .(date, model)
  ][,
    `2.5%`  := qnorm(.025, Mean, sqrt(Var))][,
    `97.5%` := qnorm(.975, Mean, sqrt(Var))
    ] |> assign(x = paste0("mean_", d))

}

rbindlist(mget(ls(pattern = "mean_")))[date >= 50] |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = `2.5%`, ymax = `97.5%`, fill = model), alpha = .7) +
  labs(
    fill    = "Graph Generating Process",
    x       = "Days since first infection",
    caption = "Based on 1,000 replicates. 95% CI of the mean",
    y       = "Mean Deaths"
    ) +
  guides(colour = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ model) +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(.2, .85),
    legend.background = element_blank()
    )
```


## Investigating networks

```{r eval = FALSE}
actors <- data.frame(id = 1:507) 

nets_ergm <- list.files("networks/", pattern = "ergm", full.names = TRUE)
ergm_degrees <- NULL
i <- 0L
for (n in nets_ergm) {

  i <- i + 1

  n_i <- read.table(n, sep = " ")

  n_i <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
    n_i + 1,
    directed = FALSE,
    vertices = actors
    )

  ergm_degrees <- rbind(
    data.table(
      net    = i,
      id     = 1:igraph::vcount(n_i),
      degree = igraph::degree(n_i)),
    ergm_degrees
    )

}

nets_degseq <- list.files("networks/", pattern = "degseq", full.names = TRUE)
degseq_degrees <- NULL
i <- 0
for (n in nets_degseq) {

  i <- i + 1

  n_i <- read.table(n, sep = " ") |> as.matrix()

  n_i <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
    n_i + 1,
    directed = FALSE,
    vertices = actors
    )

  degseq_degrees <- rbind(
    data.table(
      net    = i,
      id     = 1:igraph::vcount(n_i),
      degree = igraph::degree(n_i)),
    degseq_degrees
    )
}

differences <- data.table(
  net    = degseq_degrees$net,
  degseq = degseq_degrees$degree,
  ergm = ergm_degrees$degree
  )[, diff := degseq - ergm]
  
differences <- differences[, .(totaldiff = sum(abs(diff))), by = "net"]
```
